spacing_review.note: Accepted. Read against the two joined pieces: the left piece ends with حضرت and the right piece begins with رضا; حضرت is the title before the name رضا, as it is before the other three names in the same row, so without the space two words would run together. Checked by code point: the inserted character is U+0020 at index 44 of 100; a character that is not a space stands on each side of it; the field has no doubled space; and the mapped pieces of the two sources lie directly before and after it, so the space is the only character added. The row is Persian prose and has no Arabic field, so only this one space is in question.
